claims.text: Thorin I died in , at the age of 254, and was succeeded by his son Glóin. His sixth great-grandson, Thorin II Oakenshield, was the much famed leader of the Quest of Erebor, which reclaimed the Lonely Mountain from the dragon Smaug.
